notes.title: Orange Life - Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! This is the first  update for Orange LIFE, and it brings some improvements to gameplay, clarity, and the overall experience.  

🔧 What’s new: 

✅ Contextual Tutorial Cards – These cards help guide new players and improve the user experience.  

✅ Improved Menu System – New options and elements have been added to the menu for better navigation and control.  

✅ Bug Fixes – Multiple bugs have been fixed to make the game more stable and enjoyable. 

 🔜 I'm already working on the next update, with more features and fresh content coming soon.  🙏 Huge thanks to everyone who added the game to their wishlist, bought it, or gave feedback. Your support helps Orange LIFE grow into something truly special.  See you in Orange City! 🍊

notes.title: Orange Life - Release
notes.notes:
🚨 Official Launch Announcement – Orange Life Releases July 22! 🚨
Hey everyone!
After years of work, Orange Life is finally ready to hit the streets – and the full version launches on July 22! 🔥

🧡 Orange Life is a chaotic, immersive open-world experience where everything is interactive – from traffic lights and elevators to your own apartment. Complete missions, drive cars, explore the madness, and live the orange dream.

🚗 Full game includes:

New missions and features

Improved performance & bug fixes

A whole lot of chaos and surprises

✅ Until launch day, you can still play the FREE DEMO right now on Steam and get a taste of the action!
👉 Play the demo here

📅 Mark your calendars – July 22, 2025. Orange Life goes full release.
Thank you all for the support! This indie journey means everything.

– One Dev, One Vision, One Orange Life
